newsitem.title: CHILE: Tremors in northern Chile cause no mine damage.
newsitem.headline: Tremors in northern Chile cause no mine damage.

text.p: A nerve-rattling series of earth tremors in northern Chile's copper district, including one measuring 5.1 on the Richter scale, caused no damage or injuries, officials said.
"We were feeling tremors every couple of hours or so, none of them anything to worry about," said a secretary at the Chuquicamata mine belonging to state copper company Codelco.
"Tremors are quite common here," she said.

Spokesmen at Codelco and the National Emergency Office (Onemi) said the series of tremors started early Wednesday. The most powerful measured 5.1 on the Richter scale and was centered about 65 km north of Codelco's Chuquicamata mine.
Spokesmen at the 600,000-tonne-a-year mine, the nearby El Abra copper mine and Onemi said there was no damage and that some people hadn't even felt the tremors.
